description: Submits a filled posting form (one ad in fields, or up to 50 vacancies in items). NaRabotu validates it like its own site form and returns field errors, or saves a draft. With an e-mail, NaRabotu sends a 6-digit confirmation code to that address and returns a draft_id; without an e-mail it returns a link where the user publishes on the site. Nothing is published at this step.

email.description: The user's e-mail: the confirmation code is sent there; the ads belong to this account (created if new).

fields.description: One ad: field values by the posting form field names (city and profession may be names).

items.description: Several vacancies (kind="job" only), up to 50; each like fields.

locale.description: Language of names and links (default ru).

name: create_draft
title: Send the filled form
